decisions.reason: The email and deferred website decision applies to the copyright page, not the title page.
Copyright-page contact details do not change chapter image inclusion, placement, timing, or treatment.
The source decision does not affect chapter-image aspect ratio, cropping, pixelation, or rendering.
The copyright-page email and website choice does not alter body-text density or paragraph spacing.
The source decision concerns copyright-page contact information and leaves chapter heading formatting unchanged.
The decision about displaying an email now and a website later does not affect Mama's Hot Take styling.
The copyright-page contact-detail decision does not change the editorial review or selection of chapter images.
Choosing copyright-page contact details does not modify the existing obligation to provide paperback publishing guidance.
The email and website decision is limited to the copyright page and does not alter the paperback cover.
Copyright-page contact information does not change the manuscript's editorial-polish requirements or approved rewrites.
The source does not change KDP metadata entry, upload assistance, delivery mode, or submission support.
The copyright-page contact-detail choice does not replace or modify the authoritative manuscript revision.
